name: Doylestown Spring 2015

venue.name: [Central Bucks West High School](http://cbsd.org/cbwest)
venue.details: The competition will take place in the cafeteria.

information: The flat fee is $15 if registering online and $30 if registering at the door. Competitors will pay in cash at the door. All proceeds will be donated to the domestic violence organization A Woman's Place.
